name: WebView JavaScript-to-native bridge (addJavascriptInterface)
attack_scenario: A page loaded over http or reached via open redirect runs `AndroidBridge.getAuthToken()` or, on old APIs, `getClass().forName(...)` reflection to execute arbitrary code and exfiltrate secrets.
negative_test_hint: load an attacker-controlled page that calls "AndroidBridge.getAuthToken()" from JavaScript and assert the token is never exposed to page script

exemplar.explanation: addJavascriptInterface exposes native/Java methods to any JavaScript running in the WebView. If the WebView ever loads attacker-influenced content (redirect, MITM on http, malicious ad/iframe), that JS can call the exposed object; on API<17 it grants full reflection/RCE, and even with @JavascriptInterface it hands the page whatever the bridge does (file access, token retrieval, intents). OWASP MASVS-PLATFORM / MSTG-PLATFORM-7.
